tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, going forward. Verification is not to be disabled for local or development convenience; when testing needs a certificate the system would not otherwise trust, the project tests with self-signed certificates instead.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
